This directory contains adapted code from graphwar-aim:
https://github.com/RE22GDV/graphwar-aim

Copyright (c) 2026 RE22GDV
MIT License. See LICENSE in this directory and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt at the
project root.

Modifications: config.py was trimmed to perception-only settings; package
paths were adjusted. No solver, GUI, or application code is included.

capture.py: find_hwnd() now prefers an exact window-title match over the first
substring match. The original version returned the first visible window whose
title contained "Graphwar", which could select an editor or chat window instead
of the game. On Windows the Java client is titled exactly "Graphwar".
